condition.notes: Rail is reported missing and resistance has not yet been measured. Always start with resistance-to-ground with power disconnected.

next_steps.action: Disconnect all power sources (adapter, battery, coin cell). Wait 30 s for rails to discharge.

measure.where: Rail test point or output inductor pad
measure.instrument: DMM in resistance mode (200 ohm range first, then 2 kOhm)
measure.expected: Topology-dependent: a healthy buck output is typically >100 ohm to ground; <10 ohm indicates a hard short. Compare with a known-good board if available.
measure.safety: Capacitors must be fully discharged before measuring; never measure resistance on a powered rail.

interpretations.then: Hard short on the rail. Do NOT re-apply power. Hunt the shorted component (output cap, low-side FET, load IC) before any further diagnosis.
Marginal / soft short. Could be a partially failed FET, low-impedance load, or just the normal rail characteristic. Compare to a known-good board.
No short. Proceed to check input supply.
